قائمة dxp التجريبية التحليلية
Analytical screen tile group with a hidden header. The tile group has multi column enabled with a navbar and a sidebar. The navbar includes a favorite widget and 8 tiles setup with a 1x4 size. The navbar will stay in place, but shrink in size on smaller screens. The sidebar will wrap below all other content on small screens.
